title: 第十四章 醉月楼赎身
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
江陵城比汉口镇繁华十倍。城门洞里人潮如织，空气里飘着酒肉香和脂粉香。

    侯紫拍了拍怀里沉甸甸的储物袋。“走，先吃最好的。”

    望江楼的紫檀木桌上，红烧肉、酱肘子、清蒸江团摆得满满当当。侯紫伸手抓着肘子啃，肥油顺着胳膊往下淌。沈君壁一开始还端着，一块红烧肉下肚，筷子也松了。三年没沾过荤腥，窝头和凉茶熬过来的日子，被这顿肉冲得干干净净。

    吃完直奔澡堂。侯紫在热水池里泡了半个时辰，把山里的泥垢和血腥味全搓干净了。出来时裁缝铺的师傅已经等着，青缎子短打两身，给沈君壁也做了一身长衫。沈君壁换上新衣裳站在镜子前，伸手摸了摸袖口的针脚。“比我以前在丹霞山穿的还好。”声音很轻，像怕惊扰了什么。

    天黑时，江陵城的夜市灯火通明。侯紫站在裁缝铺门口，盯着街对面那座三层飞檐楼阁。朱红大门，一排大红灯笼上烫着“醉月楼”三个金字，丝竹声混着女人笑声飘出来。他在岳州城巷子里蹲了十六年，最羡慕的就是有钱人能进这种地方。现在兜里有金元宝，不去说不过去。

    沈君壁看了他一眼，默默跟上。

    老鸨扭着腰迎上来，扫了两人一眼，笑容淡了三分。侯紫掏出一锭五十两的银元宝拍在柜台上，老鸨的眼睛瞬间亮了，连皱纹里都堆着殷勤，引上二楼雅间。

    紫檀案几，银壶玉杯，两个粉裙姑娘弹着琵琶倒酒。侯紫靠在软垫上，觉得这辈子终于活得像个人了。沈君壁坐在角落里端着酒杯一动不动，像一尊被放错地方的石像。

    隔壁雅间忽然传来茶碗摔碎的声音。一个男人粗着嗓子骂了句脏话，紧接着是一记耳光。老鸨急匆匆跑上去赔笑，一个清冷的声音夹在中间：“我的契书上写的是卖艺。不是卖身。”

    侯紫推开门。

    走廊里，一个胖男人揪着一个年轻女子的头发往外拖。女子穿着月白色棉布裙，脸上没有脂粉，发髻上只簪着一根银簪。她不挣扎，也不哭喊，只是伸手死死抓住门框，指节发白，指甲嵌进木头里。

    老鸨在旁边骂：“欧阳琦你别敬酒不吃吃罚酒！醉月楼养了你多年，今晚你不接也得接！”

    欧阳琦抬起头，挨了耳光的半边脸红得发紫，嘴角破皮渗着血。她的眼睛没有求饶的意思。“我说了，契书上写的是卖艺。我不卖身。”

    侯紫看着那只抓着门框的手。发白的、渗着血的、不肯松开的手。
content_en:
Jiangling City is ten times more prosperous than Hankou Town.The city gate was crowded with people, and the air was filled with the aroma of wine, meat and powder.

Hou Zi patted the heavy storage bag in his arms."Let's go, eat the best first."

The rosewood table in Wangjiang Tower is filled with braised pork, braised pork ribs, and steamed glutinous rice dumplings.Hou Zi stretched out his hand to grab his elbow and gnaw on it, fat dripping down his arm.Shen Junbi was still holding it at first, but after eating a piece of braised pork, his chopsticks became loose.I haven't had any meat in three years, and the days I spent with steamed buns and herbal tea were completely washed away by this meal of meat.

After eating, we went straight to the bathhouse.Hou Zi soaked in the hot water pool for half an hour, scrubbing away all the dirt and blood smell in the mountain.When he came out, the master of the tailor shop was already waiting. He had made two short pieces of blue satin and made a long gown for Shen Junbi.Shen Junbi put on new clothes and stood in front of the mirror, reaching out and touching the stitches on the cuffs."It's better than what I wore in Danxia Mountain before." His voice was very soft, as if he was afraid of disturbing something.

When it gets dark, the night market in Jiangling City is brightly lit.Hou Zi stood at the door of the tailor shop, staring at the three-story pavilion with cornices across the street.At the vermilion gate, a row of red lanterns were engraved with three gold characters "Zuiyue Tower", and the sound of silk and bamboo mixed with the laughter of women floated out.He has been squatting in the alleys of Yuezhou City for sixteen years. What he envies most is that rich people can enter such a place.Now that I have a gold ingot in my pocket, I can't justify not taking it.

Shen Junbi glanced at him and followed silently.

The madam twisted her waist to come up to them, glanced at the two of them, and her smile weakened by three points.Hou Zi took out a fifty-tael silver ingot and slapped it on the counter. The madam's eyes instantly lit up, and even her wrinkles were full of hospitality, and she was led up to the private room on the second floor.

There are red sandalwood tables, silver pots and jade cups, and two girls in pink skirts are playing the pipa and pouring wine.Hou Zi leaned on the soft cushion, feeling that he was finally living like a human being in this life.Shen Junbi sat motionless in the corner holding a wine glass, like a stone statue that had been misplaced.

Suddenly, the sound of tea bowls breaking was heard in the private room next door.A man swore a curse word in his throat, followed by a slap in the face.The madam hurried up to apologize, and a cold voice was caught in the middle: "My deed says that I am a prostitute. It is not that I am a prostitute."

Hou Zi opened the door.

In the corridor, a fat man grabbed a young woman by her hair and dragged her out.The woman wore a moon-white cotton skirt, no makeup on her face, and only a silver hairpin in her bun.She didn't struggle or cry, she just stretched out her hand and grabbed the door frame tightly, her knuckles turned white and her nails were embedded in the wood.

The old bustard was scolding from the side: "Ouyang Qi, don't toast me and you will be fined with wine! Zuiyue Tower has raised you for many years, and you have to accept it tonight even if you don't want to!"

Ouyang Qi raised his head, the side of his face that had been slapped turned purple, and the corners of his mouth were broken and bleeding.Her eyes didn't beg for mercy."I told you, the deed says prostitution. I don't sell myself."

Hou Zi looked at the hand holding the door frame.A hand that was white, oozing with blood, and refused to let go.
